description: Bounded PAQ8p adaptive context-mixer core with two selected experts and a nested combiner; not the full compressor.

input.layout: [steps, (context_a, context_b, target_bit, x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7) repeated]

mixer_profile.prediction_order: update nested combiner from prior bit; compute each selected expert's squash(dot8 >> 5); stretch expert probabilities; compute nested squash(dot8 >> 8); train outer selected experts against current target
mixer_profile.fixed_point: source pairwise products accumulate with arithmetic signed >>8; training uses source error scale 7 and the source rounded increment; weights clamp to signed 16-bit

workspace.meaning: Includes the 4096-entry signed-32-bit stretch lookup, four expert rows, nested combiner, bounded input staging, and prediction output staging.
